cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.
